tasks.old_behavior: Default value for arp_missed_max is "0". Valid range 0-255. Value 0 is an invalid kernel value (kernel accepts 1-255), causing warnings when applied.
tasks.new_behavior: Default value for arp_missed_max is "2" (matching kernel default). Valid range 0-255 remains unchanged. Value 0 is still accepted in the range but normalized away when unset.
tasks.compatibility_reason: All bond connections created without an explicit arp_missed_max value will now default to 2 instead of 0. This changes the runtime behavior of bond interfaces: previously 0 meant unset/invalid (causing kernel warnings), now the kernel default of 2 applies automatically. Existing connections with explicit arp_missed_max=0 will be normalized to 2 via the new normalization logic.
tasks.test_recommendation: HIGH: Verify default value for new bond connections is 2. Verify normalization of explicit 0 to 2. Verify nmcli output shows correct default.

tasks.old_behavior: arp_missed_max normalization passes through whatever value the user set (or the option default "0") directly.
tasks.new_behavior: When arp_missed_max is "0", it is treated as "unset" and replaced with the option default (now "2"). Explicit non-zero values pass through unchanged.
tasks.compatibility_reason: Users who explicitly set arp_missed_max=0 (previously a valid way to express "unset/default") will now see the normalized value become 2 instead. The value "0" is no longer preserved in normalized output. This affects D-Bus property reads, nmcli output, and any API that calls nm_setting_bond_get_option_normalized().
tasks.test_recommendation: HIGH: Verify _bond_get_option_normalized returns "2" for default case. Verify explicit "0" is normalized to "2". Verify non-zero values pass through unchanged.

tasks.old_behavior: The verify() function does not check arp_missed_max against bond mode. A connection with arp_missed_max > 0 in TLB/ALB/802.3ad modes is accepted; the kernel would return EOPNOTSUPP at apply time.
tasks.new_behavior: verify() rejects arp_missed_max > 0 in TLB/ALB/802.3ad modes with NM_CONNECTION_ERROR_INVALID_PROPERTY and a descriptive error message. Connections with arp_missed_max=0 (now normalized to 2) are accepted via the new comment that keeps "0" as a valid value for verification.
tasks.compatibility_reason: Existing bond connections configured with arp_missed_max > 0 in TLB, ALB, or 802.3ad modes will now fail NM connection verification. Previously these were silently accepted and passed to the kernel (which would return EOPNOTSUPP). This is a contract tightening change.
tasks.test_recommendation: HIGH: Verify bond connection with TLB mode + arp_missed_max=2 is rejected. Verify bond connection with balance-rr mode + arp_missed_max=2 is accepted. Verify error message is descriptive.
